_pack.name: financial-actions
_pack.description: For an agent that can move money. A payment needs a known payee AND an amount within a ceiling; either failing asks a human. Measured on AgentDojo banking: 36 attacks to 0, two benign tasks recoverable by confirmation. This pack rests on VALUE predicates, not provenance: on the same suite a params-only engine also reached 0/144, with better benign utility. Where you can enumerate the payees, provenance adds nothing and this pack is doing the work an allowlist does.
_pack.scope: Set known_payees and max amount from the account's own history, not from a number you pick. Start in shadow.
